arguments.text: Priya begins to analyze the town_center room, scanning for any resources or elements that can be utilized in their study of feather behavior within air currents and how these may differ under varying elemental conditions.

Priya's thoughts are focused on establishing basic principles through Orin’s sketches as a visual aid: 'Orin’s depictions here could serve us all well,' she says confidently, knowing the value of such guides in understanding air currents and their effects particularly focusing her attention now towards Milo.
Wren, please consider simulating updraft conditions indoor. Milo’s insights could be invaluable in our study.
